exact_statement: For all n,a>=0, binary linear M:F2^n->F2^a and quadratic q:F2^n->F2, F(x,y)=(-1)^q(x)y_(Mx) on independent uniform physical controls and distinct data signs has 2^(2r+k) equal Fourier atoms, H(F)=2r+k, I(F)=1+(c+b)/2+d, and H(F)<=4(I(F)-1-d)<=4(I(F)-1). Here r=rank M, k=rank of the polar form restricted to ker M, c counts nonzero M columns, b counts zero M columns with nonzero polar row, and d counts zero M columns with zero polar row and linear q coefficient one. Under M_t=A_t M_(t-1)+B_t and q_t=q_(t-1)+p_t with quadratic p_t, Delta H_t=2 Delta r_t+Delta k_t and Delta I_t=(Delta c_t+Delta b_t)/2+Delta d_t, including arbitrary control reuse.
hypotheses: uniform independent physical controls and data signs
distinct terminal states name distinct physical data coordinates
q and every phase increment have degree at most two over F2
all state update matrices fixed over F2; no selector freshness required between stages

proof_source.locator: Rank and fiber-phase ledger theorem and Exact recursive addressing program
